findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "contaazul" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contaazul_get_charge · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: contaazul_person_write_create, contaazul_person_write_update, report_bug · Destructive: contaazul_person_delete, contaazul_delete_settlement, contaazul_terminate_contract, contaazul_delete_contract, contaazul_delete_budgets, marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contaazul_get_charge · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: contaazul_person_write_create, contaazul_person_write_update, report_bug · Destructive: contaazul_person_delete, contaazul_delete_settlement, contaazul_terminate_contract, contaazul_delete_contract, contaazul_delete_budgets, marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
